title: Aena — Gran Canaria Airport (LPA) airport page
claims: Aena lists Gran Canaria Airport under the IATA code LPA.

The airport page states that the terminal is closed to the public at night, that only boarding-pass holders and employees are allowed access during that time, and that passengers are allowed access two hours before flight departure.
The airport page lists bus and taxi among the ground transport options at the airport.
